heading: WAITING FOR PAYMENT
subtitle: Please complete the payment using your selected method.

instructions.title: Payment Instructions
steps: Open a payment application that supports QRIS (DANA, OVO, GoPay, ShopeePay, Mobile Banking, or any other e-wallet app).
Scan the QR code displayed on the payment page.
Make sure the payment amount matches the total bill.
Continue and complete the transaction in your payment application.
Once payment is successful, the system will automatically verify your transaction within a few seconds.
Do not close this page until the transaction has been processed successfully.

paymentMethod.verifyNote: After making payment, please wait for the system to verify your payment automatically
